title: pcre-devel 缺失时的 configure 报错

lines.s: checking for PCRE library ... not found
checking for PCRE library in /usr/local/ ... not found
checking for PCRE library in /usr/include/pcre/ ... not found
退出码 1；外层随后报 the HTTP rewrite module requires the PCRE library
dnf install pcre-devel 后重跑 configure 即通过
实测环境：Rocky Linux 9.3 容器（OpenResty 1.19.3.1）
